title: Bound on the stage query list
statement: Let $N$ be a sequence of finite oracle Turing machines, let $i$ be a natural number, and let $d$ be stage data. The number of queries in the list produced at stage $i$ using $d$ is strictly less than $2^{ reshLen(i,d. ound)}$.
hypotheses_covered: A sequence of finite oracle Turing machines $N$
caveat: The available description does not give mathematical notation for the length selected by the fresh-length construction or for the stage query list, so the statement retains their Lean-style names.
